Spot.doc: A named spot on the map; features find their place by name.

Feature.doc: Sizes of a spot's ground feature: radius, height, depth (m) or a rectangle size.

Path.doc: A path from this marker to the named markers (comma-separated).

District.doc: A district box (x, z size) centred here; lower order wins where boxes overlap. kind 'bounds' is the map's edge.

Plot.doc: A house plot: footprint (w, d), quarter turns, must have an upper floor.

Hangout.doc: Where villagers hang out; trip: a far destination reached over the navmesh.

Clear.doc: Keep trees, bushes and rocks this far from here.
